flux_1pro.source: public — FLUX.1-pro is a flow-matching rectified-flow diffusion model (Black Forest Labs, 2024)

flux_flex.source: public — FLUX.2-flex uses the FLUX architecture (Black Forest Labs)

flux.source: public — FLUX.2-pro uses the FLUX architecture (Black Forest Labs)

flux_max.source: public — FLUX.2-max uses the FLUX architecture (Black Forest Labs)

gemini_25.source: closed — Gemini 2.5 Flash image generation; predecessors (Imagen) are diffusion but Google has not confirmed the architecture of the Gemini-native generation path

gemini.source: closed — Gemini 3.1 Flash image generation; architecture not publicly confirmed

gemini_pro.source: closed — Gemini 3 Pro image generation; architecture not publicly confirmed

openai_1.source: closed — gpt-image-1; OpenAI has not published the architecture; may be diffusion-based or AR-integrated

grok_base.source: closed — grok-imagine-image; xAI has not published the architecture

qwen_1.source: closed — Qwen-Image; Alibaba has not confirmed the generation architecture for this model tier

qwen_20.note: anomalous outlier in cross-modality PCA: wins 'unclear'/'other' for 31/100 words, suggesting it generates images the judges cannot classify into named senses
